hero_title_mk: Where Champions Are Raised with Love
hero_desc_mk: Welcome to Kingdom of Snowstorm, an FCI-registered Bichon Frisé kennel based in Skopje, North Macedonia. Dedicated to raising healthy, loving, and extraordinary show-quality companions in the heart of our family.
box_desc_mk: Officially registered under FCI No. 11/23 and MKD No. 268. Devoted to ethical, healthy, and championship preservation of the pure Bichon Frisé.
